domain_restrictions: n, a, and b are integers
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For any integers n, a, and b with a and b between 0 and n/2 inclusive, if the value x times (n minus x) at a is at least its value at b, then a is at least b.
quantifier_order: For all integers n, a, and b
Assume 0 <= a, 0 <= b, 2*a <= n, and 2*b <= n
If a times (n minus a) is at least b times (n minus b)
Then a is at least b

variables.domain: all integers, subject to the stated inequalities
variables.name: n

variables.name: a

statement_nl: For all integers n, a, and b with 0 <= a, 0 <= b, 2*a <= n, and 2*b <= n, if a(n-a) >= b(n-b), then a >= b.
